ideas.vi: Claim là câu chủ đề cho sẵn. Why: vì sao các bạn ngại đọc. How: câu lạc bộ làm gì. Example: một bạn, một cuốn sách, một lần. Result: điều gì thay đổi. Chọn cụm khớp với tranh của Hà.
ideas.exampleEn: Why: the library feels too quiet → How: a weekly book chat → Example: Nam · a mystery novel → Result: finishes it in three days

write.vi: How nói chung cách câu lạc bộ giúp. Example kể một lần cụ thể: ai, cuốn nào, chuyện gì xảy ra. Example không được chỉ nhắc lại How.
write.exampleEn: How: Members recommend books to each other. Example: Last week, Nam lent me a mystery novel, and I finished it in two days.

write.prompt: How can a school reading club help students who rarely read for pleasure? Write a paragraph.
write.taskVi: Chép câu chủ đề, viết tiếp 4–6 câu theo thứ tự WHY / HOW – EXAMPLE – RESULT.
write.topicSentence: A school reading club can turn reading into a social activity rather than a test.
write.modelAfterSubmit: A school reading club can turn reading into a social activity rather than a test. Many students avoid books because reading feels like homework to them. A club can change this view by letting members choose books about their own interests. When members share a page they like, reading gives them something to talk about with friends. For example, at Friday's meeting, my classmate Ha showed Lan a picture of Saturn from her space book, and Lan asked to borrow it for the weekend. In this way, one book chosen for pleasure can lead other students back to reading.
